required_artifacts: hash verification of client and boot manifest
browser screenshot before and after round end

steps.assertion: Each session receives its own player ID and room
Create or join emission is observed
Each original client requests a spawn
First positional argument is JSON string; both render and identify one remote player
Input contains hdt,vdt,ts,isn,s and increases isn
Latest acknowledged isn and remote positions reconcile
Six positional shot values emitted by original client
Damage state visible to both clients under NEW rules
Kill/death state visible on both clients
Correct winner and original UI game-over table
Scalar countdown renders and both clients advance

negative_controls.name: duplicate-input
negative_controls.requirement: Server does not process identical stale isn twice

negative_controls.name: fire-rate-cheat
negative_controls.requirement: Authoritative shot validator rejects premature repeated fire

negative_controls.name: player-disconnect
negative_controls.requirement: Disconnected session cleaned without affecting other player

negative_controls.name: session-isolation
negative_controls.requirement: Private gameSetup and score updates are not misrouted

negative_controls.name: malformed-event
negative_controls.requirement: Invalid positional arity or malformed payload is rejected, never panics

acceptance: All steps must be observed against the UNMODIFIED authenticated original browser client connected to the Rust server; a synthetic injection or offline test alone is insufficient.
